description: Render PDF pages to PNG, JPEG or WebP images in a folder (one file per page, named <name>-p001.png…). Choose the DPI (72 = screen size, 150 = default, 300 = print), JPEG/WebP quality, a page range, and a transparent background for PNG/WebP. Very large pages are capped at 16384 px a side / 16.7 megapixels, like the website. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-to-images/

dpi.description: Resolution in dots per inch. Default 150.

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

output.description: Folder to write the images into (created if missing). Default: a new folder in the server output folder.

pages.description: Pages to render: 1-based list like "1-3, 5, 8-" ("5-" = to the end, "-3" = first three, "3-1" = reversed). Also "all", "odd", "even", "last". Empty = all pages.

password.description: Password, if the PDF is protected.

transparent.description: Keep the page background transparent (PNG/WebP only).

name: pdf_to_images
title: PDF to images
